title: Spynixx Launcher v1.2.9
content: Spynixx Launcher v1.2.9 is now available.
Improved GTA SA and SA-MP startup compatibility for installations using normal ASI plugin stacks.
Startup monitoring now distinguishes slow mod initialization from a genuine startup stall using process, module, thread, and window progress.
Fixed a diagnostic arithmetic overflow that could leave the launcher stuck on Starting.
Preserved verified exact-process cleanup and added session recovery after unexpected monitor failures.
Click Update Now below to securely download, verify, and install the new build.
